assets.name: Fennec - Rocket League Car
assets.creator: Jako
modifications: Converted FBX to self-contained GLB
Normalized model scale, forward axis and wheel contact height
Relinked textures and optimized them to at most 1024 pixels
Created independent steering and rolling pivots for four wheels
Added procedural rolling, front steering and chassis suspension; no animation clips were supplied

assets.name: Champions Field - Rocket League Stadium
assets.creator: Prabhu Ram / virtualmakes
modifications: Baked scene transforms and adapted orientation and proportions to the game arena
Retained stadium architecture, trophy displays and eight embedded banner textures
Replaced cinematic inner pitch and its outer shell with collision-aligned turf, ramps, walls, goals and boost pads
Reassigned placeholder colors to steel, concrete, gold and blue/orange stadium materials
Removed coincident duplicate and underground stray parts
Merged static meshes by material and spatial sector; quantized geometry without external decoders
Added reduced seat detail in low graphics mode
Updated ceiling calibration to the verified 20.48 metre arena height

assets.name: Bottled car
assets.creator: Urizel
modifications: Centered and scaled the entire supplied bottle assembly to a 2 metre novelty body
Split welded-position wheel islands without changing UV/normal seams
Added four rolling pivots and independent front steering
